verdict.rationale: Vercel's AI Gateway lets builders call hundreds of models through one endpoint with automatic fallbacks, spend controls, and usage monitoring across providers, without provisioning or managing GPUs — directly matching the story of single-call, globally-routed AI inference with no capacity planning. Multiple first-party docs (vercel-docs-2, vercel-docs-16, vercel-docs-35, vercel-docs-36) consistently describe this managed, provider-agnostic gateway model. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of global latency/routing behavior, and explicit detail on how 'global' request routing works under the hood.
